cause_quote: The introducing diff added `admittedSessionEntry.mainRestartRecovery?.tombstone !== undefined` to the recovery-owner check and called `rejectLifecycleInvalidatedWork` when `ownerClaim.kind === "invalidated"`, sending the turn into the dispatcher's existing error path.
user_saw: After restart recovery exhausted its attempts, mentioning the agent in the affected room produced no reply or recovery guidance.
summary: The fix logs visible restart-recovery rejections and sends eligible channel users one recovery reminder per session and recovery cycle while preserving the admission rejection.
reasoning: PR #96230 introduced retry-budget tombstones and added a test asserting that subsequent visible turns were rejected, while the shared dispatcher rethrew the error without sending a reply. That commit also added a notice at the moment of tombstoning, a separate path from a later inbound message. PR #130196 changed admission to throw a typed tombstone error, and the shared dispatcher still propagated it without sending recovery guidance.
